B0.name: No Clarification (Raw ASR)
B0.description: Commit raw Prisma predictions without asking user repeats

B1.name: Schema-First Alphabetical
B1.description: Prioritize structural errors/missing, then fixed alphabetical field order

B2.name: Seeded Random Selection
B2.description: Select random eligible field needing clarification using fixed seed

B3.name: Full Confirmation (Upper Bound)
B3.description: Prompt every field for confirmation, unconstrained by budget

P.name: Selective Risk Ranking
P.description: Prioritize fields with highest estimated risk (missingness, out-of-range, ambiguity)
